subject: Change request: billing entity and remit rekey — Acme Digital
messages:
From: Oliver Brandt <oliver.brandt@acme-digital.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@acme-digital.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing entity change + new remit instructions (Acme Digital)

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

Quick note from our side — Acme Digital recently did a legal reorganization and the billing entity has changed. We need to update our vendor record with Redwood so future POs and disbursements invoice to the new entity (Acme Digital Holdings LLC) and remit to the new bank account.

I attached the signed W-9 and a bank confirmation letter from our new treasury provider. Also attached the completed vendor update form (filled by our AP team). Please confirm what you need from Procurement / AP to make this live in your vendor master and whether the November 25 payroll run will pick up the new remit.

Attachments (sent): acme_w9_20261109.pdf, acme_bank_letter_20261108.pdf, vendor_update_form_20261109.pdf

Thanks,
Oliver Brandt
Sr. Procurement Lead
Acme Digital
oliver.brandt@acme-digital.com
+1 415-555-0147
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Oliver Brandt <oliver.brandt@acme-digital.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Billing entity change + new remit instructions (Acme Digital)

Thanks Oliver — looping in AP and Vendor Ops to run the standard rekey flow.

Marissa / Karthik (procurement / AP): can you confirm the checklist below and owners?
- Validate W-9 and bank letter against our KYC checklist (Vendor Ops) — Marissa
- Update vendor master: change remit entity name, add new bank account routing, and add portal owner contact (Vendor Ops) — Marissa
- Confirm whether existing open POs routed to old remit need to be reissued or can be paid with a one-time override (AP) — Karthik
- Ensure finance has a note on file about the legal entity change for audit trail (Finance) — Laura

Oliver: if you can confirm the vendor portal owner and a best contact for any payment holds that helps speed things up.

I will track; please reply with any timeline constraints.

- Mateo
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Brandt <oliver.brandt@acme-digital.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Billing entity change + new remit instructions (Acme Digital)

Hi Oliver — thanks for the docs. A couple quick items to keep this moving: 
1) We need the vendor portal owner (name + email) so we can send a secure link to upload a bank verification PDF (bank letter is a start but our policy requires either a bank micro-deposit confirmation or a bank-prepared letter with account masking).
2) Please confirm the effective date for the new remit (we'll put 11/26 as requested unless you specify otherwise).
3) We will keep the vendor record in "Pending remit update" state for audit until AP confirms the first payment on the new account.

Portal upload link (secure): https://redwood-drive.example.com/s/AcmeVendorUpdateForm
(If you prefer DocuSign for signature-backed changes, please use: https://docs.docusign.com/req/ABC-12345)

If you can return the portal owner details and indicate if an invoice is outstanding that needs reissuance, we will prioritize the change.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Brandt <oliver.brandt@acme-digital.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@acme-digital.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Billing entity change + new remit instructions (Acme Digital)

Marissa — thanks. Portal owner is: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-digital.com> (AP Manager). She will upload the bank micro-deposit screenshot and confirm the effective date. Effective date: please set to 2026-11-26.

There is one outstanding invoice (INV-55342) for $9,850 that we would like to ensure is paid on the new account; can Redwood do one-time override so it clears on 11/26? If not, let us know the reissue path.

Oliver
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Brandt <oliver.brandt@acme-digital.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-digital.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Billing entity change + new remit instructions (Acme Digital)

Hi Oliver / Samantha — good news, Vendor Ops validated the W-9 and bank letter; Samantha has uploaded the bank micro-deposit confirmation to the secure portal and we have the vendor_update_form on file. Per our AP policy and to preserve auditability, we will: 
- Update vendor master to new remit entity (Acme Digital Holdings LLC) and add the new bank routing; status set to "Active — remit updated" effective 2026-11-26.
- For INV-55342: AP will issue a one-time payment override to route the scheduled payment on 2026-11-26 to the new bank account; no need to reissue the invoice. Please allow one business day for settlement visibility.

Samantha, two asks: 1) can you confirm the last four digits of the new account so AP can match the micro-deposit? 2) please confirm a preferred payment contact for any holds/discrepancies.

Laura: tagging you for the audit note.

Thanks all — I will mark the thread closed once AP confirms the settlement has been picked up.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
